_comment: Same shape as the Sorcerer chains.json. Cleric chains are client-confirmed through the aion2.app Chain section ("1/3 -> 2/3 -> 3/3"); Metaroad charge rows and the system buff are inferred.

links.note: Earth's Retribution > Thunder and Lightning, client chain 1/3 2/3 (aion2.app); Metaroad lists them as separate ranks of one chain
Thunder and Lightning > Discharge, client chain 2/3 3/3. Discharge is described with a trigger chance (spec rank 8 +20%), base chance unknown
Judgment Thunder > Divine Punishment, client chain 1/2 2/2; spec rank 16 triggers it 1 extra time
Defiance spec rank 8 text: "Adds [Blessing of Regeneration] Chain Skill" (client text). Blessing has no unlock level of its own and inherits Defiance's 16; spec gated
Condemnation can only target a unit afflicted with Chain of Torment (client description); a condition, not a parent, Condemnation keeps its own unlock level 8
